label: Weekend of Nov 13–15
note: Ranks are MHR’s Nov 11 ratings; they move live as results come in. Game times are local to the rink.

summary: Ontario teams are the story of Day 1 at the Little Caesars Challenger Cup. Toronto Jr Canadiens are 2-0 (3-0 over Top Gun #11, 6-0 over Windy City), Chatham-Kent is 2-0 (4-1 Seacoast, 6-1 Chicago Fury), Huron-Perth beat NJ Colonials (#21) 4-1, and Upper Canada College beat Cleveland 4-1.
Fox Motors (now #29, 93.75) is 2-0, beating Boston Jr Eagles (#20) 4-1 and Seacoast (#24) 2-0. Windy City beat Biggby 3-1 before losing 6-0 to Toronto.

Little Caesars (#3, 97.59) went 2-0 (4-0 Fury, 4-2 Boston Jr Eagles). Penguins Elite (#10) went 2-0 but gave up five to Ohio in a 7-5 win. Team Illinois went 2-0, but its 4-1 win over Cleveland (#72) was smaller than expected, and it slipped from #4 to #6 (96.99).
That moves Chicago Mission back up to #5 (97.06) without playing. Woodbridge is #4 (97.08). Biggby bounced back 3-1 over St. Louis, and Masters tied Hill Academy 1-1.
